L&S General Guidelines
General Guidelines
- All courses intended to fulfill major requirements must be taken for letter-graded credit, other than courses listed, which are offered on a Pass/No Pass basis only. Other exceptions to this requirement are noted as applicable.
- No more than one upper-division course may be used to simultaneously fulfill requirements for a student's major and minor programs.
- No more than two upper-division courses may be used to simultaneously fulfill requirements for a double major.
- To maintain status in the major, a minimum grade point average of C (2.0) must be maintained in all work taken in the major.
- Students are required to complete at least a C (2.00) average in all upper division (or graduate-level) courses that are used to complete requirements for the major.

requirements.title: Russian Language
requirements.notes: Four semesters of elementary/intermediate Russian (Russian 1, 2, 3, & 4 or equivalent).

requirements.title: Upper Division Electives
requirements.notes:
Five upper-division courses in Russian and other Slavic literatures and cultures.
A maximum of 2 transfer courses is allowed.
